estimated_conflict_statistic: fraction of per-sample mean anchor cosine utilities below zero

regimes.moderate: micro-batch-anchor soft LCB routing without conflict gate
regimes.severe: micro-batch-anchor LCB routing with conflict gate

decision_rule: Continue to LLM smoke experiments only if adaptive routing is no worse than FedAvg by more than 2 pp in the zero-conflict/zero-off-task setting and significantly outperforms hard filtering in at least one setting with total corruption >= 0.6.
